# Which display blocks move for video -- stock Android, 2026-08-28
#
# Method: two idle samples 2 s apart to identify free-running registers,
# then one sample during playback. 'video-driven' excludes anything that
# already moves on its own at idle.
#
# BLOCK      regs  free-running  video-driven  verdict
# AFBD        128        8             8       ACTIVE in the video path
# TVTOP        48        0             0       static
# MIXER        32        0             0       static
# DE_OSD       32        0             0       static
# LAYER        16        0             0       static
# ROUTE         8        0             0       static
# LVDS_PHY     16        0             0       static
# PLL           8        0             0       static
# GE2D         16        0             0       static
# MIPS          4        0             0       static
# IOMMU        32        0             0       static
#
# The eight video-driven registers are the Y bases 0x05600070-7c and the
# C bases 0x05600084-90, flipping as a ring. Nothing else in any block
# differs between idle and playback.
#
# Below: the full playback sample, all 11 windows.
